comments.author: Curious
comments.body: Just being curious here, where/how are these obtained?

comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Three quests from Jakarta, all part of the same chain, give these as a (one-time?) reward:

Beyond the setting sun
Investigation of statues of Rano Raraku
Investigation of Rano Raraku

Like every other crest in the game, they're purely decorative -- no boosts to Evasion, as "Hans" alleges.
